title: Estimating the Maximum Safe Starting Dose in Initial Clinical Trials for Therapeutics in Adult Healthy Volunteers
organization: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) / CDER
summary: Authoritative regulatory guidance establishing standard reference body weights, body surface areas, and Km factors (Table 1) for converting animal doses to human equivalent doses (HED).
notes: Standard reference standard for Table 1 Km factors (Human 37, Mouse 3, Rat 6, Guinea pig 8, Rabbit 12, Dog 20, Monkeys 12, Mini-pig 27).

title: Dose translation from animal to human studies revisited
method_supported: BSA/Km Normalization and Direct Scaling Comparison
summary: Seminal peer-reviewed paper revisiting species dose translation, standardizing the formula Target Dose = Source Dose * (Km_source / Km_target), and contrasting BSA scaling with simple mg/kg scaling.
notes: Reinforces that direct mg/kg equivalence without BSA normalization can lead to dramatic overdosing in larger species.

title: A simple practice guide for dose conversion between animals and human
organization: Journal of Basic and Clinical Pharmacy
method_supported: Interspecies Dose Translation and Multi-Species Calculations
summary: Practical tutorial and reference guide on performing animal-to-human, human-to-animal, and animal-to-animal dose conversions with detailed arithmetic walkthroughs.
notes: Provides standard reference tables and practical worked examples across laboratory rodent and non-rodent species.

title: DoseMate — Dose Conversion Calculator
summary: Institutional reference application for preclinical researchers to compute interspecies doses in compliance with ICMR ethical and experimental standards.
notes: Used as functional and validation benchmark for laboratory species reference profiles.

title: Exposure and Dose Selection Guidance
organization: National Centre for the Replacement, Refinement and Reduction of Animals in Research (NC3Rs, UK)
summary: Guidelines emphasizing pharmacokinetic exposure rather than arbitrary dose scaling, warning against uncritical BSA extrapolation for non-linear kinetics or biologic therapeutics.
notes: Provides critical context on limitations, non-linear kinetics, plasma protein binding, and formulation limits.

title: Animal Characteristics: Body Weight, Strain, Sex, and Age Guidelines
summary: Detailed reference on standard baseline body weights, physiological variability, and the risk of treating all animal strains or ages as interchangeable.
notes: Underpins our requirement that reference body weights must not be conflated with actual subject weights.

title: DoseCal: a virtual calculator for dosage conversion between human and different animal species
organization: CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute (CFTRI) / Archives of Physiology and Biochemistry
summary: Specialized virtual online calculator developed by CSIR-CFTRI, Mysuru, for bidirectional dose conversion between human and laboratory animals based on BSA allometric Km correction.
notes: Foundational benchmark for bidirectional laboratory animal and human dosage calculation with actual subject body weights.
